reviews.title: Really useful app
reviews.contents:
I’ve found this app really useful for tracking milestones and suggesting new games to play with my baby that will help with their development.
I’m a big fan of the tummy time timer and widget in particular. However, one small thing… the bar chart showing tummy time by day is displaying incorrect data for me. It’s not a big deal, just slightly annoying.

reviews.title: Love love loveee this app
reviews.contents: Honestly so helpful, i found myself clueless on things to do with my baby but this app has been a lifesaver tbh. I also really like the motivational reminders, im a single mum so no one really tells me that

reviews.title: Pathways
reviews.contents: Absolutely brilliant aid for all parents and grandparents to help support and develop babies and small children. Essential toolkit. Cannot recommend enough.
